main_measure.name: mean next-day excess return x (-forecast/10) on short cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases pooled per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting difference < 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return, forecast <= -10 minus up days with forecast 0

decided_by: The main measure's mean is below 0 with t <= -2.
reading: The up day is the close-to-close return above 0 inside the window (on a window's first bar, where the previous close is not recorded, the recorded regime 'mean_reversion' stands for it); the per-day pooled t is the mean over its day-clustered standard error (deviations summed per day, G/(G-1) correction); 'up days with forecast 0' are up days by that same rule.
